skills.description: This skill should be used when the user wants to extract tables from CAD DWG/DXF drawings and export them to Excel. Trigger phrases include: 从CAD导出表格、CAD表格导出、把cad里的表格导成Excel、DXF表格提取、图纸表格转Excel、提取图中的表、extract tables from DXF/DWG. It reconstructs tables built from TEXT/MTEXT cells and LINE borders by clustering entity coordinates, restores CAD special characters, and writes a multi-sheet .xlsx.
skills.description_zh: 当用户想要从CAD DWG/DXF图纸中提取表格并将其导出到Excel时，应使用此技能。触发短语包括：从CAD导出表格、CAD表格导出、把cad里的表格导成Excel、DXF表格提取、图纸表格转Excel、提取图中的表、从DXF/DWG中提取表格。它通过聚类实体坐标来重构由TEXT/MTEXT单元格和LINE边界构建的表格，恢复CAD特殊字符，并写入多页的.xlsx文件。
skills.name: CAD表格提取
